name: National Cybersecurity Policy Framework (NCPF) for South Africa (2015)

description: National Cybersecurity Policy Framework (NCPF) for South Africa
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Government of the Republic of South Africa (gov.za) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
